_about: RULES OF ENGAGEMENT. When a team has MISSED a stake option for enough completed seasons, and the option's percentile (the average of the highest quarter of the team's 38 odds, 34 in the Bundesliga) falls in a band, an alert is sent with a stake target. Change a number here and the next check uses it. Nothing else needs touching.
_multiplier: Every stake target is multiplied by this. 1 = the normal stakes. Set 2 and 500 becomes 1000, and so on up the whole ladder.
_firstBandUpTo: Band 0 is a percentile of 16 and below.
_bandWidth: Each next band is 8 wider: 17-24 is band 1, 25-32 is band 2, 33-40 is band 3, and so on.
_seasons: Completed seasons in a row without the option: 2 in band 0, 3 in band 1, 4 in band 2, ... (firstBandSeasons + band x extraSeasonsPerBand). The seasons can keep growing.
_stake: The stake target is baseStake + band x stakeStep (500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500) and never goes above stakeCap: the seasons keep growing but the money stops at 2500.
_capAppliesTo: base = the 2500 cap applies to the ladder and the multiplier is applied after it (2500 x 2 = 5000). final = the 2500 cap applies AFTER the multiplier (the target never goes above 2500 at all).
